title: useAtom — Atomic State (Jotai-like)
ai_context: Common mistake: checking `typeof v === 'function'` is not enough when T itself could be a function type. A safer pattern is to use a wrapper like `(v instanceof Function)` or check with a dedicated `isUpdater` type guard. Also, forgetting to read the current value via `a.get()` before applying the updater leads to stale state.
